_comment: Report-only run for the compile-pipeline files that ADR 0064 waives: the four below were measured and miss the floor. packages/pipeline/build (assure, build, package, voice) is waived too and not measured: only the tests that start the SymPy verifier cover it. Not part of pnpm mutate. Static mutants (module-level constants and patterns, about 42 percent of the mutants) are skipped, because each one needs the whole test suite. The waiver lapses on _expires; packages/gates/tests/waiver.test.ts fails after that date.
